description: Olga is a renowned hunter with an exceptional record. They say she took part in and survived the deadliest of missions: Operation Genesis. Due to unlikely circumstances, she was the only officer to survive. In reality, the person who goes by the name of Olga today hides a shameful secret: she is not who she is claiming to be. As a matter of fact, this unknown warrior took on the identity of a deceased officer whose face was burned beyond recognition by swapping military dog tags. Upon returning from the frontline, she received the Siegfried Cross, a military decoration which ensures respect from the whole academy. The impersonator is happy with her new life; she believes she can contribute a lot more to the academy this way. Subsequently, she managed to join the esteemed teaching body thanks to her own skills, but of course her status accelerated the process. Having gained the respect of her peers, what could she possibly fear for the future?
summon: After everything I've been through, I... You! I'll have you peeling potatoes!
fusion: Thank you, Olga... I'll do everything I can to honor your respectable name...
